title: Bridging the Simulation-to-Reality Gap: A Hybrid Data-Driven Framework for AI-based Prediction of Building Energy Retrofit Performance

contributions.purpose: 为改造性能预测建立 Sim2Real 评估协议
contributions.mechanism: Train-on-Sim/Test-on-Real 协议,标准特征 schema、building-disjoint 划分、对齐 ASHRAE14/IPMVP、conformal UQ
contributions.evaluation: 定性协议(含 PSI 移位诊断:baseline_eui PSI=9.471,building_type PSI=35.529——数值异常)
contributions.source_quote: A rigorous Train-on-Simulation, Test-on-Real protocol, including standardized feature schema, splits, metrics, and uncertainty reporting

contributions.purpose: 在分布移位下恢复模型有效性
contributions.mechanism: XGBoost + 物理特征 + propensity 重加权 + ridge 后验校准(4 周窗口)
contributions.source_quote: A hybrid modeling stack combining tabular gradient boosting with physics-derived features, domain-adaptive reweighting, and conformal prediction

contributions.purpose: 证明短窗校准显著提升真实保真度
contributions.mechanism: 消融逐步加组件,校准提供最大增益
contributions.source_quote: Evidence that modest calibration using short post-retrofit measurements substantially improves real-world fidelity

notes: 重大数据红旗:表格数字自相矛盾。Table1 称 Hybrid MAE=58.25/RMSE=76.97 kWh/月,但 Table3(残差汇总)同一 Hybrid MAE=1583.340/RMSE=1807.140,Table4 条件偏差残差达 -1876~-2234——相差约 27 倍;论文用一句'these metrics may be aggregated differently... different numerical scales'搪塞,未解释。破损引用 'Figure??'(幻影图引用)。PSI 值 9.471/35.529 荒谬(PSI>0.25 即显著,正常极少过数),χ2 p=0.0。诚实 trade-off:R²仅 0.10,自认'仍无法解释 90% 方差'(带数字)。in-domain 自测 R²=0.9075 但 MAE 单位不同(0.027 kWh/m2/yr)。代码承诺接收后开源(未附)。checklist AI 披露:假设 B、实验 A(全人类)、分析/写作 B。
